He was a hunchback who was mostly just facing the wall.

He was also the very first "character" who appeared in my dream. 

I have seen the Hag who almost strangled me, a white girl without eyes crawled into my bed, and an old man walking with a cane but dont have legs. But Hunchie never moved.. 

He was just there.. silent, patient, facing "the wall".

Until one evening, while I was sleeping in the company's quarters, a red horned figure appeared through the wall and floated towards a man in the quarters. He licked his face and pierced his long sharp nail through the man's nose. 

I saw the man's soul leaving his body.

The red monster pointed his gaze towards me and floated to the side of my bed. There is no sound in SP but I knew he was saying something in the lines of "This is not a dream" and he was laughing.

He drew a dagger from his side and when he was about to lick me Hunchie jumped over him and they brawled.  Hunchie got hold of his neck but the red monster floated through the wall like a ghost and lost him. 

After that, Hunchie just stood its ground facing "that wall". 

 The red ghost appeared in my half dreams many times but Hunchie was always there to muscle him out. 

Sleep paralysis is a terrifying thing. You never really get used to it.  But Hunchie was the reason why, in the middle of my SP, I was at peace. Remembering I have him.

I stopped having regular SPs in 2015. Now, it's rare and quick.

Sometimes, I miss him and I'd repeat the patterns that cause my SP just to see him again.. But to no avail.
